source: Registers also participate in dependency chains. If an instruction consumes a value produced by a previous instruction, the consumer may need to wait until the result is available. Other independent instructions or warps can hide that latency. ZXNAME0000XZ’s Best Practices Guide specifically discusses hiding register dependencies through sufficient parallel work.[2]
zh: 寄存器也参与依赖链。如果一条指令消耗了前一条指令产生的值，则消费者可能需要等待，直到结果可用。其他独立指令或扭曲可以隐藏该延迟。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的最佳实践指南专门讨论了通过足够的并行工作隐藏寄存器依赖关系。 [2]
